tools.name: find_conversations
tools.description: Find recent public posts where people ask for a tool, an alternative, or help with a job, so you can decide whether an honest, disclosed reply would help them. Remote server covers Stack Exchange (incl. softwarerecs) and Bluesky; for Hacker News + GitHub run the local MCP: npx -y https://askhound.ha

tools.name: build_intent_queries
tools.description: Turn a product description into buying-intent search phrases (competitor alternatives, switching, export, pricing pain, recommendations).

tools.name: run_intent_pack
tools.description: build_intent_queries + find_conversations for every phrase, merged and deduplicated, newest first.

tools.name: reply_policy
tools.description: The honest-reply rules AskHound users agree to. Read before drafting any reply.
